verdict.rationale: AMD's page does list a few genuine spec-sheet fields (ECC support, NVMe RAID modes, supported OSes) rather than pure adjectives, but the bulk of the evidence is marketing language ('colossal 208MB', 'ultimate gaming performance') with no disclosed clock speeds, TDP/power figures, memory frequency support, or AI TOPS numbers with test conditions. missing for 10: base/boost clock specs, TDP/power figures, memory speed/support specs, AI TOPS figures with documented test conditions.
